description: Estadísticas entrada y salida de pasajeros en los aeropuertos de la República Dominicana, 2017-2026 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Departamento Aeroportuario (DA). Este conjunto de datos contiene la entrada y salida de pasajeros del Departamento Aeroportuario (DA) del 2017-2026, en el cual se puede encontrar la estadística de entrada y salida de pasajeros en los aeropuertos de la República Dominicana. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Departamento Aeroportuario (DA). Its tags are Aeropuerto, Infraestructura, Urbanismo. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
